title: PhotoStream — Instagram-like Social Media App (Frontend Plan)

requirements.summary: Add Internet Identity sign-in/out UX, keep app usable read-only when signed out, and expose the current principal to the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated visitors can view a public landing or read-only feed (if desired), but are prompted to sign in for actions that require identity (posting, liking, commenting, following).
Authenticated users can sign out and the UI updates accordingly.
User identity is derived from Internet Identity principal (no third-party auth providers).

file_operations.description: Create the app shell with top navigation (logo, feed filter, search link, profile link) and route wiring; use the existing InternetIdentityProvider context to conditionally render sign-in/sign-out and to gate identity-required actions behind a prompt instead of hard-blocking public browsing.
Add a small auth control component that uses the existing useInternetIdentity hook to render Sign in / Sign out buttons and display the current principal when authenticated.
Add a reusable wrapper/helper to prompt users to sign in when they attempt identity-required actions (post, like, comment, follow), while still allowing read-only viewing when signed out.

requirements.summary: Implement profile screens and profile editing UI using backend profile capabilities, including default avatar handling and profile counts display.
acceptanceCriteria: On first sign-in, a minimal profile is created automatically (or via a one-time onboarding screen).
Users can edit display name and bio and see changes reflected immediately after save.
Users can view another user's profile page showing avatar, display name, bio, and counts (posts, followers, following).

file_operations.description: Create a typed backend client wrapper (calling the generated backend interface methods) and helper utilities for converting values for display; keep all backend calls centralized for profile, posts, likes, comments, follow, search.

Create the profile page UI for both self and other users: avatar (fallback to generated default), display name, bio, and counts (posts, followers, following) derived from fetched profile/posts data; include follow/unfollow controls only when viewing another user.

Create profile edit UI for display name, bio, and optional avatar selection. Use the blob-storage ExternalBlob representation for avatar content references; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks for getOwnProfile/getProfile and createProfile mutation, including a first-sign-in flow that ensures a minimal profile exists (either auto-create after login or route to a one-time edit screen).

Create an Avatar component that renders profile avatars via ExternalBlob direct URL when present, otherwise uses the generated default avatar asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/default-avatar.dim_256x256.png. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire routes/navigation for viewing profiles by principal (e.g., /u/:principal) and editing the current user profile (e.g., /me/edit) so these screens are reachable from the app shell.

requirements.summary: Implement post composer UI with image selection/validation, caption input, upload progress, and publishing to the backend; ensure posts render with image references.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can create a new post by uploading an image and optionally adding a caption.
After publishing, the post appears in the feed and on the author’s profile post grid/list.
Post data includes: postId, author principal, caption, createdAt, and image content reference.
Define and enforce reasonable image size/type constraints and show a clear validation error in the UI when violated.

file_operations.description: Create a post composer screen for authenticated users: image file picker, caption, validation errors, upload/progress display, and publish action. Use blob-storage ExternalBlob (direct URL + upload progress) for image content reference creation; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks/mutations for createPost plus feed/profile post queries; ensure cache invalidation updates feed and profile posts immediately after publish.
Implement client-side image validation rules (e.g., allowed MIME types like image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp and a reasonable max size) and provide user-friendly error messages for the composer UI.
Render post images from the ExternalBlob direct URL to leverage streaming/caching. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire navigation to the composer screen (e.g., a 'New Post' action in the header) and ensure it is gated behind identity-required prompting while leaving read-only browsing accessible.

requirements.summary: Build the mobile-first home feed UI with consistent post layout, loading/empty states, and incremental loading without duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria: Feed renders a vertical list of posts with consistent spacing and responsive layout (mobile-first).
Feed loading states and empty states are implemented.
Pagination/infinite loading works without duplicating posts in the list.

file_operations.description: Create the home feed page that lists posts (image, author, caption, time) in a vertical mobile-first layout with loading skeleton/spinner, error state, and empty state using the generated illustration at frontend/public/assets/generated/empty-feed.dim_1200x800.png.
Create a reusable PostCard component that renders image, author link, caption, relative/absolute time, like/comment affordances, and consistent spacing for feed and profile views.
Add a simple incremental loading mechanism (e.g., 'Load more' or infinite scroll sentinel) implemented on the frontend list while preventing duplicates by de-duping by postId.
Set FeedPage as the primary route and ensure navigation to other required screens (search, profile, composer) is available from the app shell.

requirements.summary: Implement like/unlike and comment add/delete interactions in the UI with correct gating and immediate UI updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can like and unlike a post; like count updates in the UI.
Users can add a comment to a post and see it appear under the post.
Users can delete their own comments; other users cannot delete comments they do not own.
Backend prevents duplicate likes per user per post.

file_operations.description: Add React Query mutations for likePost/unlikePost, addComment, and deleteComment; update/invalidate cached PostView lists so like counts and comments update immediately after actions.
Create a like button component that reflects current like state for the signed-in principal, shows total like count, and prompts sign-in when unauthenticated.
Create a comments UI under each post: list comments, add comment input (gated by identity prompt), and show delete control only when the current principal matches comment author.
Integrate LikeButton and CommentsPanel into the PostCard layout, including loading/disabled states for mutations.

requirements.summary: Implement follow/unfollow UI, show follower/following counts, and add a feed filter that switches between all posts and followed-only posts.
acceptanceCriteria: On another user’s profile, a follow/unfollow button reflects current relationship state.
Follower and following counts update after follow/unfollow.
A 'Following' feed mode exists (or a clear filter/toggle) that shows posts from followed users.

file_operations.description: Add follow/unfollow React Query mutations and any needed derived UI state helpers; ensure profile-related queries are refreshed so counts and button state update after follow changes.
Create a FollowButton for other users’ profiles that prompts sign-in when unauthenticated and reflects follow/unfollow state based on current UI data and refreshed queries.

Add a clear feed mode toggle (e.g., 'All' vs 'Following') and use it to call the backend feed function with followingOnly set appropriately; ensure incremental loading does not duplicate posts when toggling modes.
Wire FollowButton into other users’ profile header and refresh visible counts after follow/unfollow; ensure the profile page remains viewable read-only when signed out.

requirements.summary: Add a discovery/search screen to find users by display name and navigate to their profiles, with loading and empty-result states.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can search and see a list of matching profiles.
Selecting a result navigates to the selected user’s profile page.
Search has loading and empty-result states.

file_operations.description: Create a search page with a search input and results list showing avatar + display name; implement loading, error, and empty-result states; navigate to the selected profile route on selection.
Add a React Query hook for searchUsers with debouncing and request cancellation behavior appropriate for type-ahead search.
Create a result row component that uses the Avatar component (default avatar fallback) and links to the profile page route.
Register the SearchPage route and add navigation access to it from the app shell.

requirements.summary: Define and apply a consistent visual theme (non-blue/purple primary palette) across the app shell and all screens.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI uses a consistent design system (spacing, typography scale, button styles, card/post layout).
Theme is distinct and coherent, with accessible contrast for text and interactive elements.
The primary palette is not blue/purple unless explicitly requested later.

file_operations.description: Create global styles and CSS variables used by Tailwind/shadcn theming, selecting a primary palette that is not blue/purple (e.g., warm neutrals/greens/oranges) and ensuring accessible contrast; apply consistent typography and spacing defaults.
Adjust Tailwind theme tokens if needed to match the chosen palette and ensure consistent container/spacing; keep usage aligned with existing CSS variable-driven color setup.
Create a layout component to enforce consistent page padding, max width, header styling, and overall app structure across Feed, Profile, Composer, and Search screens.
Wrap routed screens with AppLayout and ensure consistent UI elements (header, nav actions) match the design system across the app.

requirements.summary: Wire generated static images (logo, default avatar, empty-state illustration) into the UI as frontend static assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced by the UI.
Default avatar is used when a user has not set an avatar.
Empty-state illustration is shown when feed/search has no content.

file_operations.description: Create a Logo component that renders the generated wordmark from frontend/public/assets/generated/app-logo.dim_512x512.png and is used in the app header.
Ensure the Avatar component uses frontend/public/assets/generated/default-avatar.dim_256x256.png as the fallback when no avatar is set.
Show the generated empty feed illustration frontend/public/assets/generated/empty-feed.dim_1200x800.png when the feed has no posts.
Show the generated empty-state illustration frontend/public/assets/generated/empty-feed.dim_1200x800.png (or a suitable empty-state block using it) when search returns no results.
Add the generated app logo asset at the required path so the UI can reference it as a static file.
Add the generated default avatar asset at the required path so the UI can reference it as a static file.
Add the generated empty-state illustration asset at the required path so the UI can reference it as a static file.
